row.notes: (sc, carIdx) Finds participant (+0xa0 cache / scan); false if flags +0x32 bit7 or 0x40, +0x36 bits 2/0x10/0x18, +0x35 >= 0x40, or not running (+0x32 bit 0x20); else converts sc speed sc+0x4c (mph -> m/s) and returns participant+0x84 < v < participant+0x88. Callers Sess_SafetyCar_OnLapChanged, Sess_Rules_ReadSafetyCarPacePenalties. Hypothesis.

verify.notes: V3739 Flag tests +0x32 bit7/0x40/0x20, +0x36 bits 2/0x10/0x18, +0x35 >=0x40, mph->m/s (*1.609344/0.001/3600), returns +0x84 < v < +0x88; callers OnLapChanged and ReadSafetyCarPacePenalties verified.
